prompt: I have a Python script that needs to atomically update multiple keys for the same user in a Valkey cluster. Write code that updates user:123:profile, user:123:settings, and user:123:last_seen using a batch operation. Make sure it works in cluster mode.

assertions.name: Uses ClusterBatch not Batch
assertions.description: Should use ClusterBatch for cluster client, not regular Batch

assertions.name: Uses hash tags for same slot
assertions.description: Should use hash tags like {user:123} to ensure all keys are in same slot

assertions.name: Uses raise_on_error=True
assertions.description: Should use raise_on_error=True for atomic behavior

assertions.name: Uses GlideClusterClient
assertions.description: Should use GlideClusterClient (not GlideClient) for cluster mode

assertions.name: Uses async context manager
assertions.description: Should use 'async with GlideClusterClient' for cleanup
